links.rule: In the city's own capital budget these projects were paid for with bond proceeds, TransNet (a voter-approved regional sales tax that can only fund transportation) and developer impact fees; bond proceeds can only fund capital projects, so none of this money could have paid for day-to-day services like police, parks or libraries.
